note: 1차에서 medium 이 6/6 전부 easy 로 갔다. medium 으로 실제로 분류되는 문형을 찾기 위한 2차 후보. hard 예비 후보도 함께 던진다.

questions.text: Implement a thread-safe LRU cache with O(1) get and put, and explain how you keep it correct under concurrent access.
Write a SQL query that returns the second highest salary in each department, and explain the window function you used.
Refactor callback-based Node.js code into async/await and explain what changes about error handling.
Given an array of intervals, merge the overlapping ones and analyze the time and space complexity of your solution.
Explain the CAP theorem and give a concrete example of a production system that chooses availability over consistency.
Walk through step by step what happens when you type a URL into a browser and press enter.
Compare REST and GraphQL for a mobile client on an intermittent network connection.
A Spring Boot application throws LazyInitializationException when serializing an entity. Explain the cause and give two different fixes with their trade-offs.
Write a function that detects a cycle in a directed graph and returns the nodes on the cycle.
Explain how garbage collection works in the JVM and why G1 replaced CMS as the default collector.
Design a database schema for a simple e-commerce order system covering products, orders, and inventory.
How would you unit test a function that depends on the current system time? Show the approach in code.
Prove the correctness of Dijkstra's algorithm using a loop invariant, then explain exactly where the proof breaks once negative edge weights are allowed.
Design a globally distributed strongly consistent counter. Analyze the latency lower bound imposed by the speed of light between regions and justify the consistency model you pick.
Compare Raft and Paxos in detail, explain why Raft's leader-based design simplifies implementation but constrains throughput, and propose a concrete modification that relaxes that constraint.

Given a 10TB dataset that no longer fits in memory, design an external sorting pipeline, derive its I/O complexity, and explain how you would tune the merge fan-in against available RAM and disk seek cost.
